hero_badge: EpistleChat is coming to the App Store
hero_intro: SilentStudios is an independent studio making calm, beautifully built software. Less noise, more meaning, and the details you feel before you notice them.
apps_intro: We'd rather ship one thing people love than ten things they forget. Here's what's on our desk right now.
epistle_card_text: Private chats. Beautiful letters. An end-to-end encrypted messenger for iPhone, with letters worth keeping and communities you'll love. Coming soon to the App Store.
kraylus_card_text: Our next big idea: a finance app for payments, digital assets and point of sale, built with the same calm and care. Still on the drawing board.
statement: We believe the best technology is *quiet.* It respects your attention, earns your trust, and _gets out of the way_ so the people you care about can come through.
about_intro: SilentStudios is a small, independent team designing and building apps end to end. No investors to please and no ads to sell, just products we'd want on our own home screens.

values.title: Craft over volume
values.text: We sweat the spacing, the timing of every animation and the words on every button, because that's where trust is built.

values.title: Privacy by default
values.text: Your conversations are yours. We collect what's needed to make the app work and nothing we'd be uncomfortable explaining.

values.title: Built in the open
values.text: We share what we're making as we make it. Join the waitlist and you'll hear about it first, with no spam.

contact_intro: Press, partnerships, feedback or just a kind word. We read everything.
letter_text: Dear you, thank you for every late-night call, every terrible joke and every time you showed up. Some words deserve more than a text bubble, so here they are, sealed in wax.
